scripts.build: npm run build -w @planilla/web-workspace && npm run build -w @planilla/web-landing
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @planilla/web-workspace && npm run typecheck -w @planilla/web-landing
scripts.test:local: npm ci && npm run typecheck && npm run check && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply planilla-inteligente --remote --config apps/web-workspace/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply planilla-inteligente-preview --remote --config apps/web-workspace/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply planilla-inteligente --local --config apps/web-workspace/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to apps/web-workspace/.wrangler/state
